## Observations

- `coop --git` at 100 steps passed 3/10 (`30%`), outperforming `solo` at 100 steps (`1/10` and `0/10`) and even `solo` at 250 steps (`2/10`). All 3 passing pairs (`dottxt_ai_outlines_task/1655`, `openai_tiktoken_task/0`, `pallets_jinja_task/1621`) succeeded via genuine `clean` (`naive`) 3-way merges (`11` to `30` peer messages, `57` to `98` steps per agent, `2` to `7` compactions per agent) because each agent only had to fit one feature inside its 100-step / 28K-compaction budget.
- Three more pairs (`dspy_task/8394`, `go_chi_task/26`, `huggingface_datasets_task/6252`) passed one of the two features while the partner hit step 100 with `patch_lines == 0`; in the remaining 4 pairs, both peers hit step 100 with `patch_lines == 0` (`13/20` agents hit `LimitsExceeded`, `0` merge conflicts).
- Concurrency check at `-c 5` (10 concurrent `coop` agents) matched our input-TPM model closely: peak `986,251` input tokens/min against the 1M/min cap (`7` `429` retries, `2` `5xx` retries, `0` agent errors, 59 min wall time).
